summary.estimated_transfer_method: Planetary Computer assets are whole-tile COGs (about 1 GB of B02+B03+B04+B08 per scene, HEAD of 4 scenes); the pipeline reads only the AOI window. Per scene, bytes = footprint fraction of the AOI x C, where C = 35.8 MB (with SCL-first block skipping) to 48.9 MB (no skipping), calibrated on the 2024-01 workload (16 scenes, summed footprint fraction 7.94): new pipeline 284.1 MB (GDAL downloaded_bytes), baseline 388.3 MB (NIC rx, no skipping). A rebuilt month needs all its scenes, not only the missing ones. STAC items carry no file:size.
